title: Short Term/Vacation Rental Survey
description: The City of Dallas uses this service request to track and survey customers about possible issues regarding short term rental/vacation properties. Information provided in this service request will be used for tracking purposes only. If assistance from a service department is needed, please submit the appropriate service request in addition to this survey. Please note, this survey is regarding possible violations occurring when a property is rented out to a tenant temporarily (Ex AirBNB, Homestay, Vacasa, etc.)

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to survey a possible short-term rental violation.
actions.why: For possible violations involving a home, apartment, or condominium rented temporarily to tenants, such as an Airbnb, Homestay, or Vacasa, including frequent rental nuisances like noise or loud music, parking, large gatherings, criminal activity, litter, or another concern. The 311 request form asks whether the residence has an ongoing nuisance related to frequent rentals and whether it is rented for less than 30 consecutive days.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Short Term/Vacation Rental Survey" requests is for tracking and survey purposes only, not for requesting assistance from a service department. If you need department assistance, then also submit the appropriate 311 service request.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Under "Other Requests", choose "Short Term/Vacation Rental Survey"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Under "Other Requests", choose "Short Term/Vacation Rental Survey"
